facts.text: Salicylic Acid + LHA 2% Body Wash
Gently exfoliates, smoothens skin & reduces body acne

A gentle, exfoliating body wash that provides bump-free soft skin without compromising the skin barrier. It contains a powerful combination of Salicylic Acid (BHA) + LHA in a combination of 2% with mild surfactants.
"Helped me a lot with my body acne, cleanses the body pretty well and never actually made my skin itch ( i have a sensitive skin)" -Aditya S.
Contains Salicylic Acid (BHA) that penetrates deep into the skin & scoops out the dirt, debris, and sebum, hence reduces excess sebum and makes skin feel refreshed

Formulated with Capryloyl Salicylic Acid (LHA), which unlike Salicylic Acid, stays on outer layer of skin and provides gentle exfoliation, revealing soft skin. The combination provides multi-level exfoliation
Boosted with Niacinamide along with ingredients like Betaine & Glycerin for hydrating & soothing skin
All our ingredients are sourced from leading global supplier. Our Saliyclic Acid comes from Merck, Germany and is a high purity grade ingredient
Concerns: Excess Sweat, Body Acne & Rough Skin
Suitable for: 16+ years of age
The product has been evaluated for safety through patch testing under the supervision of a Dermatologist.
Wet your skin thoroughly. Take out ample quantity and massage the body wash on your skin gently. Rinse off thoroughly.
When to use: AM & PM, Everyday.

Salicylic Acid is a relatively smaller molecule with molecular weight of 138 g/mol, and about 58% of Salicylic Acid is able to penetrate our outermost skin layer (Stratum Corneum). This results in deeper cleaning, exfoliation and anti-acne benefits

Capryloyl Salicylic Acid (LHA) is a larger molecule with molecular weight of 264 g/mol, making it almost double the size of Salicylic Acid. Because of this, only 6% of LHA penetrates past Stratum Corneum, making it excellent for superficial skin exfoliation
A form of vitamin B3, Niacinamide is a superstar ingredient that repairs skin barrier, soothes, and stimulates ceramide synthesis

Water/Aqua, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate, Coco-Glucoside, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Acrylates Copolymer, Acrylates Crosspolymer-4, Glycerin, Sodium Lauroamphoacetate, Salicylic Acid, Capryloyl Salicylic Acid, Sodium PCA, Betaine, Niacinamide, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Sodium Hydroxide, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate

facts.section: Which skin types is this suitable for?
facts.text: While the body wash can be used by all skin types, it’s highly recommended for oily / combination or acne-prone body skin. The combination of actives helps to reduce the excess sebum and also reduces the occurrence of acne. For combination skin, while cleansing, focus more on the oily t-zone by massaging more there and be gentle on the drier parts of the face ensuring thorough and consistent cleansing.

facts.section: Can this product be used for men & women both?
facts.text: Yes. This body wash works equally well for both men and women.

facts.section: What is the recommended age for using this body wash?
facts.text: Anyone over 15 years of age can use this body wash.
Pregnant or breastfeeding individuals should not use this product without consulting their healthcare provider first.
